label: Framework SSR · 32-card catalog
boundary: Production HTTP request, routing, SSR and framework response serialization to complete uncompressed HTML over loopback. Static fixture input is available locally; no database or external I/O. Full-document caching is disabled.
parity: Same main landmark, heading, 32 ordered article identities and exact title/category/description/formatted price/conditional stock/tag values and roles. A request-specific URL value must be reflected. Generated CSS classes, presentational text wrappers and framework scripts/checkpoints outside business content may differ; full response bytes are retained and validated.
limitations: Different framework shells and hydration protocols produce different payload sizes.
This workload does not measure browser hydration, application startup, database I/O or developer experience.
A separate contract and capture from the synchronous pure-renderer suite; numbers must not be combined.
